ops-bot: Pager: HIGH - TruBlue Health tenant heartbeat failure rate > 5% for 2m (pager duty triggered) :rotating_light:
Aisha (oncall): getting it. seeing a burst of heartbeat failures from tenant tru_blue in the last 3m. paging flowback.
Aisha (oncall): baseline heartbeat failure normally ~0.2% so 5% is a big spike. I'm on the incident channel.
Jonas (eng-sre): ping me. any deploys to routing or gateway in the last 30m?
Aisha (oncall): not from our releases team. rolling infra changes? nothing in deploy bot.
ops-bot: Deploybot: no successful deploys to routing or gateway in the last 60m.
Marta (prod-observability): I can see a spike in 503s for TruBlue tag on the edge-router metric, correlated with increased queue depth on model-serving pool b.
Priya (customer-success): FYI TruBlue reported a slowdown in UI and some error pop-ups ~10:22AM local. they're on standby.
Aisha (oncall): ok plan: (1) mute noisy pager to reduce paging flood while we triage; (2) enable fallback routing to model-variant c for TruBlue; (3) add temporary debounce on the tenant check and update dashboard.
Jonas (eng-sre): agree. I'll add a 10m silence for this pager on PD and flip routing.
Jonas (eng-sre): creating silence: `pd silence create --service "heartbeat-checks" --description "TruBlue spike" --duration 10m`
ops-bot: PagerDuty: silence created by Jonas - 10m for service heartbeat-checks.
Jonas (eng-sre): applying fallback routing for tenant tru_blue: `rb config set-route --tenant tru_blue --route model-variant-c --reason "mitigate pool b queue spike"`
Aisha (oncall): pushing route change now.
ops-bot: Routing: route set for tenant tru_blue -> model-variant-c (effective immediately).
Marta (prod-observability): flipping route dropped error rate for tru_blue from 5.3% to 1.1% within 30s. latency still slightly elevated.
Priya (customer-success): Told TruBlue we routed traffic to a lower-capacity but more stable variant; they asked if this affects accuracy. I said we would monitor quality and follow up.
Aisha (oncall): next we need an alert throttle and debounce fix. current tenant-specific check evaluates 60s windows with a 3-trigger threshold, that's too chatty on short bursts.
Aisha (oncall): Proposed change: evaluate over 5m with a 2/5 rolling windows and include a min_request_volume=50 to avoid noisy tenants.
Marta (prod-observability): here's the proposed monitoring patch (YAML):

```
alert: tenant_heartbeat_failure
expr: sum(rate(heartbeat_failures_total{tenant="tru_blue"}[5m])) / sum(rate(heartbeat_total{tenant="tru_blue"}[5m])) > 0.02
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/heartbeat-tenant
  owner: eng-sre
```

Aisha (oncall): that looks good. also add `min_samples: 50` to the check in the alerting backend so tiny tenants don't cause pages.
Jonas (eng-sre): i'll deploy the alert change to staging then prod. planning a quick rollout with canary to avoid missing real incidents.
Marta (prod-observability): I'll create a short-lived TruBlue dashboard panel: 503 rate, queue depth, lat50/95 for model pool b and c, plus request volume. URL: https://grafana.redwood/tru_blue-live (temp)
Priya (customer-success): Can you add a simple note on the panel about the temporary model fallback so I can show TruBlue?
Marta (prod-observability): done. added annotation at 1768459999 "fallback routing applied" and a short description.
Aisha (oncall): status update: errors down to 0.9%, latency improving, Pager silenced for 10m. rolling into followup actions:
- lock in alert evaluation change (5m window + min_samples)
- create durable dashboard (not temp) with playbook links
- schedule postmortem with TruBlue CS and eng-sre if we see any SLA blips after metric-normalize

Aisha (oncall): Priya, can you start a customer-facing note to TruBlue that explains what happened and the fallback action? keep it calm and technical.
Priya (customer-success): on it. will draft and share for review in ~15m.
Jonas (eng-sre): alert config rolled to prod at 1768460300. added min_samples=50.
ops-bot: AlertManager: tenant_heartbeat_failure alert updated and applied.
Marta (prod-observability): long-run mitigation: we should add a per-tenant debounce service that aggregates short bursts and only fires when sustained across multiple pools. creating ticket INF-4827.
Aisha (oncall): creating post-incident checklist now, will link the ticket and assign owners.
Priya (customer-success): TruBlue confirmed UI recovering, they appreciate the quick routing fallback. requested confirmation once normal variant is safe to return to.
Aisha (oncall): leave routing pinned to variant-c for 30m while we watch and run canary traffic back.
Jonas (eng-sre): pinned for 30m. I will monitor pool b queue and rollback when QD < 50 and error_rate < 0.5% for 10m.
Aisha (oncall): last note: let's not forget to reduce the noise surface by adding tenant watchlist gates to the alerting UI so noisy tenants can be throttled without global rule edits. filing INF-4828.
Marta (prod-observability): summarizing post-ops actions in the internal incident doc: INF-4826-tru_blue-heartbeat-spike. I'll include graphs, the YAML change, annotations, and customer note.
Priya (customer-success): thanks team. I'll post the customer note after review.
Aisha (oncall): closing this thread when metrics stable for 30m. right now last_message_ts=1768461400.
ops-bot: Incident: page resolved (silence expired) - please open the incident doc for postmortem if needed. :white_check_mark:
